* Journal entry: “I think I almost want to target like my confidence and how I view myself, which will probably send us back in my timeline to my old job and maybe even farther, who knows. I suspect it might be a more deep rooted thing because I academically was extremely successful through high school, and even did okay in college. I excelled at literally everything when I was a kid, and know I don’t have that constant reinforcement of report cards, feedback from my dance teacher, other important adult figures, etc., and I feel like I should be able to reinforce that on my own, but can’t. My old job wrecked any remaining confidence I had. Also, my confidence in my physical appearance isn’t great but it is better than it was like a year ago, I have put in the work to ‘fix’ that. But my main issue is my confidence in life in general. I feel like I haven’t amounted to anything. Additionally, I’m like satisfied with where we are in life, but Marcus is like not. He wants to make like double his current salary, maybe own a business, be able to support me and a family, have a bigger nicer house, nicer vehicles, a boat, live in a nicer area, etc. And he feels this constant pressure to do that and so nothing we have or do right now feels good enough to him, he is always wanting MORE and I think that contributes to this as well, since I’m always hearing from him that he wishes he had this, wishes he had that, etc.

Also I think my general headspace and emotional state is contributing to even worsening confidence. For example, I’m sleeping in more so I can get better and more sleep, so I’m not working standard 9-5 hours each day, but moreso doing like 10-6 or 10-5 and then maybe working a bit later in the day, or playing catch up on the weekends. I feel lazy and unmotivated for not waking up and working like a ‘normal person’. I feel like I’m then constantly almost like internally accusing myself of being like overdramatic and trying to convince myself that I don’t actually feel like shit but instead am making it up in my head to rationalize my want to sleep in later."
